data.narrative:
Isomorphic Labs is a private-stage biotech company that has raised $600M to date. The valuation landscape includes 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, notably Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Two standard valuation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-median analysis cannot proceed because no subset of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier private comparables yielded three or more datapoints—a minimum threshold for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring using the Biotech & Health median price-to-sales multiple of 5.5x also cannot be applied because Isomorphic Labs' revenue is not on file, which is typical for private companies at this stage. Without disclosed or estimated revenue, the P/S multiple cannot generate a valuation output.

The absence of narrow comparables and missing revenue data prevent quantitative triangulation at this time. A defensible valuation would require either: disclosure or reliable revenue estimation for Isomorphic Labs; identification of additional private comparables with disclosed funding rounds and valuations at similar or proximate funding stages; or a shift to alternative methods such as precedent transaction analysis or venture capital method discounting. Until such data becomes available, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range with appropriate confidence.
